symbols.read: Price has edged up to 720.38, still capped by the 722.40 lower pivot, so the neutral-to-cautious bearish tilt holds and the invalidated SELL setup stays dead but not reversed. What changed versus the previous read: the 726.00–726.48 bear FVG remains filled, a new bull FVG has opened just below at 718.50–718.88, and the 1H has ticked up (+0.12%) while staying in a downtrend, with the 4H still Bearish against a BULLISH regime. Invalidation: a hold above 737.02 confirms a full trend reversal and kills the downside case; a loss of 715.60 (now reinforced by the bull FVG beneath it) would revive bearish momentum toward the 686.36 target.

The neutral-hold bias holds and has firmed slightly: the 1H trend has flipped back up and a small bullish FVG (81,494.01–81,527.36) has reopened just below price, restoring a thin support cushion that was absent in the prior read. The downside path toward 81,033.66 is now less clean than before, with the FVG and rising 1H momentum in the way; a clean break below 81,033.66 reopens 77,715.32, while acceptance above 84,352.00 flips structure bullish.

Conviction stays weak until one of those levels gives, so this is a confirmation of the prior read, not a revision.

Bias stays neutral-to-hold: the SELL remains invalidated, 4H is still bearish and 1H still down, with the BULLISH regime flag keeping shorts off the table. What changed is the FVG picture — the bear FVG at 1.296–1.2998 that previously sat under price has been consumed, leaving no open FVGs, so the overhead supply cap that defined the last read is gone and price is now sitting at 1.30 with a clean slate.
